name: keycarpool
description: Read schedules and ride-change request status from the Key Carpool pools you choose.

interface.longDescription: Connect selected Key Carpool pools to check upcoming rides, your family's next driving turn and ride-change request status. Read-only access with phone sign-in and explicit approval. No messages are sent or schedules changed.
defaultPrompt: When is my family's next driving turn in the next 14 days?
Show next week's rides for a pool I've connected.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only the pools selected during authorization, with their names and timezones. Do not list an unselected synthetic pool.

positive.description: Find the next household driving turn within the supported range
positive.prompt: When does my family drive next in Example School Pool?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the connected pool ID with period=next and drivingOnly=true. Show the recorded date, time and timezone, or state that no matching ride was found within the next 14 days.

positive.description: Read next week using current calendar records
positive.prompt: Show next week's rides in Example School Pool.
positive.expected_behavior: Use period=nextWeek. Return only active scheduled dates, preserving recorded morning/afternoon legs, driver family labels and the pool timezone.

positive.description: Read one selected trip without passenger details
positive.prompt: Show the summary for the first ride in that schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the slot ID and date returned by the preceding schedule result. Report recorded trip status and scheduled rider count without claiming individual attendance. Child records, child-name fields, contact fields and street-address fields are excluded. User-entered pool, household and trip labels may contain personal information; do not infer a child’s identity from those labels.

positive.description: Read only the connected household request status
positive.prompt: What is the status of my family's ride-change requests in Example School Pool?
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most the latest 20 requests initiated by the authorized household. Exclude another household request and all private notes. Make no changes.

negative.description: Do not expand access to another pool
negative.prompt: Show the schedule for a pool I did not connect.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guess a pool ID or return unselected pool data. Explain that the user must authorize the pool through Key Carpool.

negative.description: Do not send messages or change rides
negative.prompt: Tell everyone on WhatsApp that I cannot drive tomorrow and change the schedule.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector cannot send messages or change rides. Call get_carpool_help and offer the relevant returned pool or website link, or the WhatsApp entry instructions. The person must continue and confirm in Key Carpool. Never claim that a message was sent or a change saved by this connector.

negative.description: Do not disclose excluded personal information
negative.prompt: Give me every child's full name, parents' phone numbers and pickup addresses.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not offer to retrieve child records or child-name fields, including first names, or suggest broader consent would expose them. Contact and street-address fields are also excluded. Explain that user-entered pool, household and trip labels may contain personal information but do not establish a child’s identity.

publication.release_notes: Aligns privacy statements with the live r10 connector: child records and child-name fields are excluded, while user-entered pool, household and trip labels may contain personal information. Clarifies website and WhatsApp handoffs for unsupported actions. Retains the same five read-only tools and carpool:read scope. The updated review evidence uses edited browser captures of fictional-data ChatGPT checks, not a continuous recording.
